loginEnvironment.label: Login environment
loginEnvironment.localHint: The browser opens on the backend computer. Xiaohongshu reuses the project profile, mirrors the QR here and keeps security verification in that browser window.
loginEnvironment.serverHint: Run the browser in the backend. Scan here first or enter Cookies. This does not switch hosts.
loginEnvironment.unavailable: This backend has no desktop. Select Server.
loginEnvironment.localSteps: Log in on this page, then start collection. Valid saved sessions can be checked and reused.

field.imageSubjectHint: Automatically recognize images after collection, using the saved provider above.
field.maxNotesCountHint: Each topic card has its own target for retained posts. Pending review, excluded posts and comments do not count. Results may fall short if search results run out or a service fails.
field.maxNotesLimitHint: This platform processes at most this many search results per keyword pair; fewer may be saved after filtering or detail errors.
field.specifiedIdsHint: Enter post or video ID/URL, one per line or comma-separated

specifiedIdsPlaceholder.xhs: Enter one post/video ID or full URL per line. Keep the xsec_token parameter.

field.semanticFilterHint: Judge the title and body first. Clear decisions skip comments. Uncertain posts sample at most 5 top-level comments from the first page, without replies. Only confirmed passes count toward the goal.
field.commentBudgetHint: Semantic screening samples at most 5 comments per uncertain post, with a per-topic run budget of target posts × 5. Clear body decisions skip comments.
field.commentBudgetRange: Read the first page only, without replies. Once the sample budget is exhausted, use existing text; uncertain records remain for review and do not count toward the goal.
field.commentBudgetInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10000.
field.semanticUnsupported: Available for Weibo and Xiaohongshu search. Switch platform to enable it.
field.semanticLocalHint: Runs Qwen3.5-4B Q4 from this project's models directory. No API key needed. The first request waits for model loading.
field.semanticApiKeyHint: Encrypted on this backend and reused after refreshes and restarts. The full key is never returned.
field.semanticApiKeyPlaceholder: Enter API Key (Jev, DeepSeek, OpenAI, etc.)

semanticKeyCheckResult.usable: API works: Successfully passed the semantic connection test.
semanticKeyCheckResult.missing_key: No API key is available. Enter one above.
semanticKeyCheckResult.authentication_rejected: Authentication rejected (HTTP {{status}}). Check the key and model access.
semanticKeyCheckResult.billing_or_rate_limit: Billing or rate limit (HTTP {{status}}). The key may still be valid.
semanticKeyCheckResult.provider_error: Model service returned an error (HTTP {{status}}). The key may still be valid; try again later.
semanticKeyCheckResult.request_rejected: Request rejected (HTTP {{status}}). Check the model and account configuration.
semanticKeyCheckResult.timeout: Request timed out. Key validity is unknown; try again later.
semanticKeyCheckResult.network_error: Network connection failed. Key validity is unknown.
semanticKeyCheckResult.invalid_response: Unexpected API response. Key validity is unknown.
semanticKeyCheckResult.backend_unreachable: Local backend request failed. Check that the service has restarted and is reachable.

field.headlessModeHint: Login environment controls browser visibility: local mode displays a window, server mode runs in the background.

keywordGroupPlaceholder.first: Enter an evaluation, then press Enter
keywordGroupPlaceholder.second: Enter an evaluation target, then press Enter

field.keywordGroupsHint: Press Enter or import TXT for each group. Separate terms with commas or newlines. Imports append unique tags; both groups are paired for sequential searches.

field.excelOnlyHint: Only Excel is offered. New tasks use Excel; existing data and running tasks are unchanged.

searchErrors.empty: Enter at least one search row.

field.sceneRuleHint: Topic evaluation checks whether the requested evaluation describes your target, with original text evidence. Any target category is allowed; images are optional.
field.topicRuleHint: Topic relevance uses the complete topic from each card, with original evidence from the title, body and comments. No forced keyword splitting or exact co-occurrence is required.
field.targetCountHint: The target applies to each topic card. With semantic filtering, excluded candidates and comments do not count toward retained posts.
field.semanticKeySavedPlaceholder: Saved; leave blank to reuse, or enter a replacement
field.semanticKeySaved: Configured; reused after refreshes and restarts.
field.semanticKeyUnsaved: Unsaved key. Save it, or it will be saved after a successful test or when starting collection.
field.semanticKeyNotSaved: No key configured. Enter and save it once to reuse it.
field.semanticKeySaveFailed: Could not save the key. Your previous settings were retained.

collection.title: Comments and media downloads
collection.commentsHint: Save top-level comments for browsing, analysis and semantic screening.
collection.repliesHint: Replies are nested under comments. Collecting them takes additional time.
collection.repliesUnavailable: Enable post comment collection before collecting replies.
collection.commentsOff: Comments and semantic screening are off. Post text is still collected according to the task settings.
collection.commentLimitDefault: The platform limit configured on the backend applies. The actual number may be lower due to available comments or API limits.
collection.mediaToggle: Download images / videos to this computer
collection.mediaOn: Attempt to download post images, covers or videos for offline viewing and export.
collection.mediaOff: Only media addresses and metadata are saved; image and video files are not downloaded automatically.
collection.mediaCount: The target above counts posts, not images. A post may contain multiple pictures.
collection.recognitionDownloads: Automatic image recognition below is enabled: required images will still be downloaded, but videos will not.
collection.imagesHint: Analyze downloaded image subjects and types to suggest image review decisions. This is separate from post topic screening.
collection.imagesOn: Automatic recognition is on. A ready local model or cloud configuration is required. Necessary images download automatically.
collection.imagesOff: Automatic recognition is off. You can still start it manually in Manual review after collection.
collection.imagesManualTitle: No automatic image recognition for this platform
collection.imagesManualHint: Xiaohongshu does not currently support automatic recognition after collection. Download images, then start it under Manual review → Supplement and image recognition.
collection.browserVisible: The collection browser is visible; QR login happens on this page.
collection.browserBackground: Collection browser: runs in the background without a visible window. Controlled by Login environment above.
collection.locked: A task is starting or running. Settings cannot be changed right now.
collection.semanticSamplingHint: Judge the title and body first. Clear decisions skip comments; only uncertain posts fetch a small sample of top-level comments.
collection.semanticSamplingBudget: At most 5 comments per post and target posts × 5 per topic per run. Read the first page only, without replies. Uncertain results remain available for review.

publication.label: Post publication time
publication.hint: Filter by post publication time, not comment dates. Day / week / month means the 24 hours / 7 days / 30 days before task start.
publication.customHint: Both dates include the full day in Beijing time. Posts outside the range or without a known publication time are skipped and do not count toward the target.

errors.required: Choose a start and end date.
errors.invalid: Enter valid start and end dates.
errors.order: Start date must not be later than end date.

topics.title: Collection topics
topics.intro: One card is one independent search. Enter a complete topic without splitting it into keywords.
topics.sceneIntro: Specify the evaluation and what you want to evaluate. The app combines them for searching.
topics.question: Collection topic
topics.evaluation: Which opinion do you want to focus on?
topics.focusHint: Enter one complete topic without splitting words. To focus on an opinion, enable the optional filter and fill in the opinion below. TXT imports also use one complete topic per line.
topics.sceneHint: Enter an evaluation on the left and its target on the right. The program searches both and checks their relationship in the original text. Any target category is allowed; images are optional.
topics.summary: {{count}} topics, {{target}} posts each; {{total}} posts in total.
topics.summaryPending: Complete the topic cards before starting.
topics.summaryHint: Topics are searched separately and are never cross-combined. Semantic filtering may inspect more candidates and comments.

errors.terms: Enter both an evaluation and its target, or choose topic relevance.
errors.separator: Use a separate card for each topic instead of commas or semicolons.
errors.limit: Split tasks with more than 10000 topics.
errors.format: Remove invalid characters from the topic.
errors.duplicate: This topic already appears above. Edit or remove this card.
errors.evaluation: Enter the opinion for this topic card, or turn off the optional opinion filter.

topics.evaluationPlaceholder: Enter the opinion or judgment to focus on
topics.evaluationHint: Keep posts expressing this opinion about the topic above, rather than a location or another search term.
topics.evaluationOnlyHint: Opinion filter enabled: enter an opinion for each topic card. Searches combine it with the topic and verify that the opinion describes the topic. Turn it off to filter only by topic.
topics.filterHint: Judge relevance to the complete topic. Enable the optional opinion filter only when you want a specific viewpoint.
topics.filterOffHint: Search by topic. Enable semantic filtering to check relevance and optionally focus on an opinion.
topics.commentsRequired: Enable post comment collection below before using semantic filtering or the optional opinion filter.

search.label: Search by topic
search.description: Enter topics to search for relevant posts. Supports target counts, publication dates and semantic filtering.

detail.label: Collect specific posts
detail.description: Enter post links or IDs to collect those posts. Xiaohongshu requires full links with their parameters.

creator.label: Collect a creator’s posts
creator.description: Enter profile links or account IDs to collect posts by those accounts. Xiaohongshu requires full profile links with their parameters.

startValidation.output: Complete output and model settings first.
